recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-42747 request without changing the ServiceRequest model; FHIR-32265 should remain supporting context rather than a separately decided issue in this worker result.
issue_request: FHIR-42747 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core ServiceRequest. It reported that the example titled "Order for mechanical ventilation with order details" had the order-detail content commented out and resolved to uncomment/add multiple orderDetails and multiple parameters, with FHIR-32265 and the ServiceRequest Parameters page as context.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3204 initially applied the issue via commit 25298e96747255a29bdb9b20287c6c9aa1f6912e, later merged by a20a61fc78ab98338c3170a3884a5aa6898b8fa0. That change replaced commented-out legacy orderDetail content with one ServiceRequest.orderDetail containing one parameter, which left the approved multiplicity request only partially applied.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini and the ventilation example is listed in source/servicerequest/list-ServiceRequest-examples.xml, so source/servicerequest/servicerequest-example-ventilation.xml is current build source. FHIR-32265 defines the current orderDetail backbone shape with optional parameterFocus and repeating parameter; the cited Confluence page and FHIR-32265 comments provide the Puritan Bennett mechanical ventilation settings and oxygen saturation target used as content guidance. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/servicerequest/servicerequest-example-ventilation.xml to contain two orderDetail elements and nine parameter elements, including a parameterFocusReference for the ventilator, ventilator mode/rate/pressure/PEEP/FiO2/tube compensation/tidal volume parameters, an oxygen saturation goal, and monitoring instructions.
source_changes: source/servicerequest/servicerequest-example-ventilation.xml: replaced the single-parameter orderDetail block with two orderDetail blocks and nine parameter entries grounded in the cited mechanical ventilation use case.

related_jiras.note: Defines the ServiceRequest.orderDetail backbone and provides the mechanical ventilation parameter example that FHIR-42747 explicitly cites.
